proposed_requirement_ac_text: `create_app(app_config_dir=None, enforce_single_instance=True)` builds and returns the routed FastHTML app in the selected config root, installs middleware/handlers and runtime state, skips PID work only when requested, repairs an existing corrupt DB by backup/recreate, and degrades runtime-bootstrap failures to wizard mode instead of exporting imported route handlers as API.

routes_or_registry_hooks: Registers root routes/mounts listed at source lines 260-486
signatures: create_app(app_config_dir: str | Path | None = None, enforce_single_instance: bool = True)
accepted_inputs_and_boundaries: `app_config_dir` selects process-local SQLite, PID, runtime-state, and backtest-log roots.
`enforce_single_instance=False` skips the PID guard; `True` checks/writes a PID in the selected config directory.
observable_outputs: Returns the FastHTML root app with auth, init/feature/registry middleware, exception handlers, redirects, routes, mounts, and app state populated.
The app state exposes `runtime`, `strategy_runtime_manager`, and the effective `app_config_dir`; mounted apps receive root/runtime references.
failure_error_fallback: An unreadable existing DB is renamed to `*.corrupt.<timestamp>.db` and reinitialized; a missing DB initialization error or failed backup propagates.
Runtime bootstrap errors are logged and fall back to an app with `runtime=None` so the initialization wizard remains reachable.
A live duplicate PID raises `RuntimeError`; malformed/stale PID files are removed.
state_mutations_and_cleanup: Sets the process config override, initializes SQLite and optional dev stubs, may start scheduler/runtime services, initializes auth, writes app/mounted-app state, and may write a PID.
PID cleanup is registered with `atexit`; dev-stub cleanup is owned by `ensure_dev_stubs_started`.
normative_contract.evidence_note: `__all__` explicitly limits the module API to `create_app`; imported handlers and framework classes are implementation dependencies.

proposed_acs.statement: `create_app(app_config_dir=None, enforce_single_instance=True)` builds and returns the routed FastHTML app in the selected config root, installs middleware/handlers and runtime state, skips PID work only when requested, repairs an existing corrupt DB by backup/recreate, and degrades runtime-bootstrap failures to wizard mode instead of exporting imported route handlers as API.
